S: Granny Smith apples and cinnamon baked in a sweet shortcrust
Apple pie of Granny Smiths, sugar and cinnamon in a double crust, baked at 190C for 50 minutes, served in wedges with strong drip coffee.

Pork shoulder marinated in guajillo, achiote, orange and pineapple, charred and sliced thin into corn tortillas with grilled pineapple, onion, coriander and salsa verde. Blitz 3 soaked guajillo chillies with 2 tbsp achiote paste, the juice of an orange, 100ml pineapple juice, 3 garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin and salt. Marinate 1kg thinly sliced pork shoulder overnight. Cook in a very hot pan in batches until charred at the edges. Grill 4 pineapple rings and chop. Fill 16 warm corn tortillas with pork, pineapple, diced white onion, coriander and salsa verde.
Fresh shucked oysters on ice with lemon and shallot mignonette
Freshly shucked oysters on ice with a shallot and red wine vinegar mignonette and lemon.
M: Hanna's three-hour beef and pork ragù
Beef and pork ragù simmered with red wine and a parmesan rind

Beef and pork ragù simmered slowly with red wine, tomato and a parmesan rind until rich and glossy, tossed through rigatoni with plenty of grated parmesan. Soften a diced onion, carrot and celery stick in olive oil. Add 400g beef mince and 300g pork mince and brown hard. Pour in 200ml red wine and reduce, then add 2 tins crushed tomatoes, a parmesan rind and 250ml water. Simmer gently for 3 hours, topping up with water. Cook 500g rigatoni, toss through the ragù with a splash of pasta water and grate 60g parmesan over.
Neil's rule about walking out in thirty seconds flat

Dry-brined rib eye seared hard and butter basted, rested and sliced, with a loaded baked potato and garlicky creamed spinach. Salt 4 rib eyes and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Bake 4 potatoes at 200C for 1 hour. Sear the steaks in a smoking pan 3 minutes a side, then baste with 40g butter, garlic and thyme until 54C inside, and rest 8 minutes. Wilt 400g spinach with a crushed garlic clove, add 150ml cream and 30g parmesan and reduce. Split the potatoes and top with sour cream, chives and crisp bacon.
W: Baked cheesecake on a cookie crust, chilled until set

New York cheesecake: cream cheese, sugar, eggs and sour cream on a biscuit base, baked in a water bath at 150C for an hour, cooled in the oven. Mix 250g crushed biscuits with 100g melted butter and press into a tin. Beat 750g cream cheese with 200g sugar, 3 eggs and 150g sour cream. Bake in a water bath at 150C for an hour and cool in the oven. Chill overnight.
K: Face-to-face cold brew with cinnamon cream
Cold brew steeped 12 hours, topped with brown sugar cinnamon cream

Strong coffee steeped cold overnight, poured over ice and topped with a float of cinnamon and brown sugar cream that slowly drifts down. Stir 100g coarse ground coffee into 1L cold water and leave in the fridge for 12 hours, then strain through a fine sieve lined with paper towel. Whisk 150ml cream with 1 tbsp brown sugar and half a tsp cinnamon until just thickened. Fill four glasses with ice, pour in 200ml cold brew each and spoon the cream over the top.

s.note: Granny Smith apples and cinnamon baked in a sweet shortcrust
s.how: Toss 1kg sliced Granny Smith apples with 100g caster sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and 1 tbsp flour. Fill a 23cm dish lined with sweet shortcrust, cover with a second sheet, cut vents and bake at 190C for 50 minutes. Serve in wedges with cream and strong drip coffee from 60g ground coffee.
